title: Goalpara
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
info: Goalpariya folk songs, Dhubri border area
body:
Goalpara is a town and district in western Assam, on the south bank of the Brahmaputra, near Meghalaya and Bangladesh.

Goalpariya culture

Goalpara is famous for Goalpariya folk songs (lokageet), sung in the local dialect and popularised by Pratima Barua Pandey, whose song Hastir Kanya (about elephants) is widely known.

History

The old Goalpara district once covered much of western Assam. The town was a river trade centre, and nearby are the Urpad Beel (wetland) and the forests of the Meghalaya foothills.
